---
name: Bug report
about: Reproducible incorrect behavior in Village
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe what you expected and what happened.

## Reproduce safely

List steps in fixture mode or a scratch village, commit/build, browser/device and relevant feature flags.
Never reproduce resets, disasters or other debug actions on the shared live village.

## Evidence

Include sanitized errors and synthetic screenshots. Remove credentials, phone numbers, personal photos and voice samples.

## Impact

Who is affected, how often, and is there a workaround?

## Suggested scope

Relevant paths, related task/decision and any proposed contract change. Leave ownership/allowed paths to the integrator.
